Оверлей — отдельное окно поверх игры; в: The overlay is a separate window on top of the game; nothing is injected into the game, so anti-cheats leave it alone. It shows in windowed and borderless mode and in most modern games; in the old exclusive fullscreen mode Windows won't display it — switch the game to borderless windowed.
FPS, 1 % и график времени кадра есть, то: FPS, 1% low and the frame time chart are there only while the app records frames: with administrator rights and not in VALORANT or League of Legends. Otherwise their cells show “—”. The overlay costs the app almost nothing: numbers refresh twice a second, with no animations.

Окно оверлея не забирает фокус и пропуск: The overlay window never takes focus and lets the mouse pass through: clicks go to the game. Numbers refresh twice a second.
Страница в домашней сети: пока идёт игра: A page on your home network: while you play, your phone shows FPS, CPU and graphics card load, memory, and ping. The app injects nothing into the game, so anti-cheats have no reason to flag it; if you like, you can also turn on the overlay — a separate window on top of the game.
Как и любое окно поверх игры, оверлей ин: Like any window on top of a game, the overlay sometimes makes Windows send the game's frames through the shared desktop instead of directly — display latency can grow by about one frame (on modern graphics cards Windows often avoids this). If every millisecond counts in a competitive game, hide the overlay with the shortcut.
